answer: Admission auctions block fake identities: 200 slots open each epoch, each applicant sealing a bid in copper tokens locked 20 epochs, the clearing price setting entry. A dune of bids rises, but only the top 200 win, so a forger must outbid honest agents on every fake. A basalt-hard rule bars refunds, so 1,000 fakes at 50 POA each cost 50,000 POA with no return. An honest agent pays once, recovers its bid in 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
